title: What's New: AI Development Toolkit (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Multi-Language Support and Copilot Credit Insights
Summary of AI Development Toolkit updates

features.name: AI Development Toolkit renamed
features.description: The development toolkit for extending copilot is now called the AI Development Toolkit to reflect its expanded capabilities beyond just using Azure Open AI, including designing and coding agents in Business Central.

features.name: Agent development and design
features.description: The toolkit now supports designing and coding agents in Business Central. This capability has been in public preview since February with nearly 1,500 agents built by the community.
features.status_evidence_quote: The latter has actually been in public preview since the beginning of February.

features.name: BC AI Resources authentication simplified
features.description: The requirement to authenticate BC AI Resources using your own partner subscription has been removed. The set managed resource authorization method now has a new signature that omits passing subscription details.
caveats: Old method is obsoleted but still available for backward compatibility

features.name: Content filtering policies
features.description: Support for content filtering policies in Azure Open AI with granular control. Supports low and medium harmful content filtering levels, with low as the default. High setting not supported in managed resources but available with own Azure Open AI subscription.
caveats: Only low and medium filtering supported in managed resources
High setting requires approval from Azure Open AI and own subscription
Low is default and allows least harmful content

features.name: Azure Open AI policy parameters codeunit
features.description: New codeunit for managing Azure Open AI policy parameters including content filtering settings. Allows developers to set filtering levels when calling LLM APIs.

features.name: Prompt injection protection
features.description: Support for Azure AI content prompt shields to protect against prompt injection attacks. Uses detection tags and XPI detection settings to block malicious attempts to inject instructions through external data.
caveats: Requires calling detecting tags for untrusted prompts
XPI detection must be enabled separately

features.name: AI evaluation tool renamed to evaluation
features.description: The AI test tool is now referred to as AI development toolkit evaluation to reflect it is part of the broader toolkit. Provides data-driven AI evaluations for Copilot and agent development.

features.name: Evaluation suite configurations
features.description: New feature to define and manage evaluation suite configurations with standardized parameters: capability, test type, and execution frequency (daily, weekly, manual). Configurations are extensible and can be used in APIs and pipelines.
caveats: Configuration does not automatically run evaluations, requires manual uptake in pipelines

features.name: Multi-language evaluation support
features.description: Built-in language support for evaluations allowing developers to test Copilot and agent features globally. Test inputs are now categorized by languages, allowing developers to specify language and name in data sets and run evaluations across multiple languages.
caveats: Data set names must be common across languages for tool recognition
Requires specifying name and language in data sets

features.name: Copilot credit insights in evaluations
features.description: Developers can now see Copilot credit consumption for evaluations broken down per run, per line, and per data set entry. Credits used are visible directly in the evaluation results and log entries.

features.name: Agent evaluation support
features.description: Developers can build and validate AI agents in Business Central by selecting agents to run in evaluations, inspecting agent tasks per run, line, and data set entry. Developers can inspect which tasks were created during agent runs, visible at run, line, and individual data entry levels.

features.name: Agent library
features.description: Upcoming capability to provide additional agent evaluation options for testing agents in the AI Development Toolkit.
features.status_evidence_quote: very soon we'll have an agent library coming giving you even more capabilities to test agents
